title: Pass Statement

lines.explanation: This for loop statement is read in the following way: iterate through each letter in the string 'Python'
it checks if the current letter is 'h'
This statement dones nothing...actually nothing. It is used when a statement is required syntactically but you do not want any command or code to execute.
This statement will print all the letters including 'h' because the 'pass' statement actually does nothing
